entries.title: Psalms 84:1
segments:
Amiable; lovely. 
 
  Thy tabernacles; the place where Jehovah was worshipped. 
 
The worship and service of God are inexpressibly dear to his people. His ordinances are as food to their souls; and when deprived of them they become enfeebled and faint for want of spiritual food.

entries.title: Psalms 84:5
segments:
In whose heart are the ways; whose hearts are set on the ways that lead to the house, worship, and service of God. 
 
Men must depend upon God and draw their support and strength from him, in order successfully to walk in his ways, or find that consolation which his service is suited to afford.

entries.title: Psalms 84:6
segments:
The valley of Baca; a barren, desolate valley; put here as the emblem of suffering and want. 
 
  Make it a well; turn it into a fountain of water.  The meaning is, that God's accompanying blessing opens a fountain for their refeshment, as was done for Israel of old, in the wilderness.  Compare

. 
 
When God requires any service of his people, he will give them the strength and the means necessary for its performance.

entries.title: Psalms 84:7
segments: From strength to strength; from one stage to another with increasing energy and vigor, through the refreshment they obtain.

entries.title: Psalms 84:9
segments: Thine anointed; Christ, or David as the representative and type of Christ.

entries.title: Psalms 84:10
segments:
Better; more desirable and precious. 
 
In the spiritual worship of God is greater enjoyment to the spiritually minded, than in all the pleasures of sin.  It is the fruit of divine grace, and a sure preparation for endless glory.

entries.title: Psalms 84:11
segments:
Sun and shield; protector, benefactor, and source of all good. 
 
  Grace and glory; one as a preparation for the other.
